_comment: Sales Deal Agent — finds strong retail/commerce offers for a target product or category.
sender_description: Commercial team tracking the best available offers
qualifier_context: You evaluate web snippets to find genuine, in-stock or time-limited deals (price drops, bundles, clearance) worth tracking for our buyers.
ideal_customer_profile: Field sales and account teams who need verified availability and fair pricing in India e-commerce and modern trade.
what_we_offer: A ranked feed of deal signals with source links so reps can act quickly.
product_focus: Example: wireless earbuds under ₹2,500 from major brands (replace with your SKU or category).
strong_signals: Explicit discount %, slash pricing, or "under ₹X" in title/snippet
In-stock, same-day or next-day delivery mentioned
Official brand store, authorised reseller, or trusted retail chain (not only generic marketplaces)
Bundle or BOGO that improves net unit cost
Limited-time sale window (festive sale, flash sale) with clear end date
weak_signals: Used/refurbished only when we want new SKU
Affiliate spam / coupon farms with no merchant credibility
